questions.question: On this day in 1847, the acclaimed classic novel Jane Eyre by Charlotte Brontë was published under which pen name?
questions.explanation: Brontë originally brought out Jane Eyre under the male pseudonym Currer Bell with publisher Smith, Elder & Co.
questions.context:
On this day in 1847: The novel Jane Eyre is published in London.
Jane Eyre (1847 novel by Charlotte Brontë): Jane Eyre is a novel by the English writer Charlotte Brontë. It was published under her pen name "Currer Bell" on 19 October 1847 by Smith, Elder & Co. of London. The first American edition was published in January 1848 by Harper & Brothers of New York.

questions.question: The 2026 documentary film You Can See Everything, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, follows the life of which Theranos founder prior to her imprisonment?
questions.explanation: The documentary centres on Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her partner Billy Evans in the period leading up to her prison sentence.
questions.context: You Can See Everything (2026 documentary film by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim): You Can See Everything is a 2026 American documentary film directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. It follows Elizabeth Holmes, the founder of the defunct health technology company Theranos, and her partner Billy Evans, who invite a film crew to document them beginning in the weeks before Holmes began serving a United States federal prison sentence for defrauding investors.

questions.question: Anirudh Ravichander, renowned for his work primarily in Tamil cinema, is celebrated in which creative profession?
questions.explanation: Ravichander is a prominent music composer and playback singer who has won numerous accolades including two Filmfare Awards South.
questions.context: Anirudh Ravichander (Indian composer and playback singer (born 1990)): Anirudh Ravichander, also credited mononymously as Anirudh, is an Indian composer and playback singer who works primarily in Tamil cinema. He has also composed for Telugu and Hindi films. He has won two Filmfare Awards South, ten SIIMA Awards, six Edison Awards and five Vijay awards.

questions.question: Along with Edmund Hillary, which Sherpa mountaineer became one of the first two climbers confirmed to reach the summit of Mount Everest in May 1953?
questions.explanation: Tenzing Norgay reached the summit of Mount Everest on 29 May 1953 alongside New Zealand mountaineer Edmund Hillary.
questions.context: Tenzing Norgay (Nepalese-Indian mountaineer (1914–1986)): Tenzing Norgay, born Namgyal Wangdi, and also referred to as Sherpa Tenzing, was a Nepalese-Indian Sherpa mountaineer. On 29 May 1953, he and Edmund Hillary were the first people confirmed to have reached the summit of Mount Everest, as part of the 1953 British Mount Everest expedition. Time named Norgay one of the 100 most influential people of the 20th century.

questions.question: In the political thriller television series The Diplomat, Keri Russell plays an American diplomat who unexpectedly receives an ambassadorial posting to which country?
questions.explanation: Debora Cahn's series stars Russell as a seasoned diplomat named US ambassador to the Court of St James's in the United Kingdom.
questions.context: The Diplomat (American TV series) (2023 Netflix political thriller by Debora Cahn): The Diplomat is an American political thriller television series with elements of a romantic comedy. It was created by Debora Cahn. First airing in 2023, it stars Keri Russell as a veteran US diplomat who is unexpectedly appointed as the ambassador to the United Kingdom amid an emerging international crisis.
